riskFactors.title: Geographic Concentration
riskFactors.description: 86% of portfolio value in Kuala Lumpur (Mid Valley + The Gardens) with Southkey JB adding geographic spread.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Southkey acquisition adds Johor Bahru exposure (~14%)
Johor Bahru provides Singapore corridor exposure
Both KL malls in prime established locations

aggravatingFactors.factor: Singapore corridor competition may affect Southkey

riskFactors.title: Fixed-Rate Debt Protection
riskFactors.description: 100% fixed-rate debt at 4.49% through MTN issuance provides complete protection from rate volatility.

riskFactors.title: Related Party Considerations
riskFactors.description: 45.8% sponsor ownership by IGB Berhad with Southkey acquisition as related party transaction requires monitoring.

aggravatingFactors.factor: Southkey acquisition was related party transaction

riskFactors.title: Strong Disclosure Standards
riskFactors.description: Comprehensive disclosure of mall-level metrics, lease expiry profiles, and quarterly performance data.

riskFactors.title: 2026 Lease Expiry Concentration
riskFactors.description: 40.5% of Mid Valley NLA (40.5% of total) expiring in 2026 creates significant lease rollover risk.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Diversified tenant base reduces single-tenant risk

aggravatingFactors.factor: 40.5% concentration in single year is elevated
Market conditions may pressure rental rates
MVM is flagship asset - disruption impact high

riskFactors.title: IGB Berhad Sponsor Support
riskFactors.description: Long-standing sponsor relationship with demonstrated support through Southkey acquisition at favorable terms.

mitigatingFactors.factor: IGB Group 50+ year Malaysian property track record

observations.title: Transformative Southkey Acquisition
observations.content: FY2025 marked transformative RM1.215B Southkey acquisition, expanding portfolio to 3 malls and driving 11.4% DPU growth to record 11.56 sen.
observations.summary: 11.4% DPU growth, RM1.215B Southkey acquisition, record performance

observations.title: Excellent Debt Structure
observations.content: 100% fixed-rate debt at 4.49% provides complete rate protection. Conservative 31% gearing with exceptional 9.6x interest coverage and ~19pp headroom to 50% limit.

observations.title: Near-Perfect Occupancy
observations.content: Portfolio maintains ~100% occupancy across all 3 malls (MVM, TGM, Southkey), demonstrating exceptional asset quality and tenant demand.

observations.title: 2026 Lease Expiry Headwind
observations.content: 40.5% of Mid Valley NLA expiring in 2026 presents significant leasing task. Historical tenant retention is strong but rental reversion risk exists in current market.
observations.summary: 40.5% MVM NLA expiry in 2026 - key monitoring point
